From [[Brandon Sanderson]]'s [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/blog/844/Mistborn-Minifigs-Sale-Updates website]:

Brandon's assistant Peter here again. Brandon is still [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/events out on the road]; at this moment he's at the Joseph-Beth bookstore in Lexington KY, hopefully with a fully recovered voice. Tomorrow he'll be in my old stomping grounds at Books&Co. near Dayton OH. (I used to ride my bike 12 miles to their original store location almost every Saturday, though I still haven't been to their new location. Some of my family members may show up to bother Brandon tomorrow. If you see them, say hi for me.)

A note about the Atlanta signings on Friday: There are actually two separate signings, one in Clarkston at 3:30 p.m. and one in Norcross at 7:00 p.m. Right now we only have details for the Norcross signing here on the site, but you can see the details for the Clarkston signing at [http://gatheringstormtour.com/ Macmillan's tour page].

The folks at [http://mediawonder.com/mini/index.php?main_page=index&cPath=10 Garden Ninja Studios] have announced a sale on their Mistborn miniatures/figurines (and also on their Goblin Quest miniatures). All are 30% off until the end of January. They also have a new [http://mediawonder.com/mini/index.php?main_page=index&cPath=19 Sergeant Schlock] miniature (from [http://schlockmercenary.com/ Schlock Mercenary] by Howard Tayler, who you should be familiar with if you listen to the [http://www.writingexcuses.com/ Writing Excuses] podcast regularly).

Speaking of Writing Excuses, in [http://www.writingexcuses.com/2009/11/08/ this week's episode] comics writer Jake Black fills in for Brandon to talk with Dan and Howard about writing comics. [http://www.writingexcuses.com/2009/11/08/ Check it out].

Finally, in the most recent MISTBORN 3 annotations, Brandon mentions [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/annotation/301/Mistborn-3-Chapter-Thirty-Six talking scenes and the number sixteen], [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/annotation/302/Mistborn-3-Chapter-Thirty-Seven the loss of half the sieging Koloss], and [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/annotation/303/Mistborn-3-Chapter-Thirty-Seven-Part-2 everyone's favorite Koloss, Human].
